prompt: I need to add a new AI feature to Muse — a 'track description' generator that takes a track ID and generates a paragraph describing the track (genre, mood, instrumentation, vibe) using OpenAI. What files do I need to touch in the Go backend and how should I structure it?

assertions.name: mentions AIClient interface
assertions.description: Response mentions adding GenerateTrackDescription to the AIClient interface in client.go

assertions.name: covers all 7 module files
assertions.description: Response covers client.go, model.go, service.go, handler.go, repository.go, dto.go, routes.go

assertions.name: includes migration file
assertions.description: Response includes creating a SQL migration for track_descriptions table

assertions.name: references module pattern
assertions.description: Response references the handler → service → repository module pattern

assertions.name: mentions fallback client
assertions.description: Response mentions implementing on fallbackClient for when no API key is set

assertions.name: includes frontend integration
assertions.description: Response mentions updating frontend API routes/enums/types
